teacher_info.about_teacher:
As an active learner of several languages, I can understand many of the challenges that my students face. My goal is to provide a teaching environment where my students feel they can express as freely as they want, and are not afraid to make mistakes. It is also my opinion that learning, like many things in life, is more about the process than the destination, so keeping students engaged and interested is what I aim for in every lesson. 

I believe that understanding the culture is essential to learning any language. That's why in my lessons, I will try to introduce my students to some cultural background, drawing from my own personal experiences wherever I can.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching style is quite relaxed, and I can tailor the lesson based on my student’s needs and interests. Having said that, I believe the best way to learn any language is through casual conversations with a native speaker, hence the lessons will generally be informal and conversational. 

I’m always open to ideas so if you would like to focus on any specific topics or run a lesson a certain way, let me know!

pro_course_detail.title: Business Interview Skills and preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
Go into your interview armed with phrases and responses that aim to impress! 

This class is perfect for learners who want to make sure that they know what questions to expect in an interview, as well as the best way to use English in your responses to these questions.

Let's work through some interview preparation, ranging from how to present yourself all the way through to questions and responses - all relevant to your industry!

Already familiar with the interview process? That is perfect - we can spend the time going over your answers and making sure your use of English is correct.
 
* added bonus: I will proof read your resume at no additional charge and suggest changes needed to make your resume more receptive and understandable to an English employer. This is for a resume that is already written.

pro_course_detail.title: Informal tutoring and conversation practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice your general conversation skills!

There is no stress or pressure in these classes, they are more informal, fun and relaxed! Let's chat about anything and everything while you are learning English! This can just be a great way to practice general conversation skills looking at fluency and understanding, while gaining your confidence talking to a native English speaker.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Combine informal tutoring with grammar!

In these classes, we will look at a mixture of general conversation around important daily tasks (such as travel/going to the bank/etc), and then combine it with any grammar and pronunciation issues that come up.

Let's work together to make you feel as comfortable as possible when needing to manage and perform daily activities in English!

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description:

- Spelling

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you need help navigating the business climate in English so that you can grow in the workplace?

Then this is the class for you! Running a small business myself, I understand how important effective communication is in this field. Let's work together through your areas of concern so that you are left feeling more confident and prepared.

- practice business pronunciation specific to your industry
- Get ready for a business conference 
- learn the correct business English terminology
- learn how to debate and interrupt politely in English
- improve your English negotiation skills
- focus on small talk in the work place
- improve how you communicate in business meetings
* these are just some examples of what we can work on!

Please give me some guidance on what you need to achieve with these lessons once you have booked, so that we can work through the appropriate materials.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Lessons and proofreading (documents, essays, emails, etc)
pro_course_detail.description:
PROOFREADING:
Would you like someone to proofread your writing to check that your intended meaning is understood? Are you unsure of whether you have made any spelling or grammar errors in an important document?

Let me help you proofread your documentation/email/essay/application.

In this lesson you will be required to send me your own material, as I will only be proofreading and making corrections (I do not write anything on your behalf)


WRITING LESSONS
Writing essays, creative and functional, is a real passion of mine and I would love to work with you through this process!

- Do you struggle to write essays for school?
- Are you wanting to create the perfect college application essay, but aren't sure where to start?
- Do you want to take your essay to the next level, creating a piece that is engaging, interesting and unique?

Let me help you do this!

We will work through the following process in this class:
- Learn the importance of planning
- Learn how to plan efficiently and effectively
- Learn how to put together a draft essay, and how to edit this effectively
- Learn how to recognise sentence errors and to correct spelling and grammar errors
- Put together a finished product that you can really relate to and be proud of!

I will be with you every step of the way, helping you to be prepared so that you can take your writing to the next level!

Help with:
* college/visa/job/immigration/internship application essays
* high school essays
* junior school essays
* letter writing (formal and informal)
